# All Fluence Trading (AFT)

> All Fluence Trading (AFT) makes the AFT Trading Bots, automated futures strategies for TradingView, and teaches futures traders to read the market with The All Fluence indicator and a six-chapter course. The membership is The All Fluence indicator for TradingView, a six-chapter course that teaches the method behind it, and a premium Discord. Two instrument-specific indicators, the MNQ Master Trader (Micro Nasdaq) and the MGC Master Trader (Micro Gold), come with it as a bonus: extra signals on top of All Fluence. Educational software and training only: not a signals service, not investment advice, no performance promises.

Membership is sold on Whop. 14-day free trial. Cancel inside the 14 days and you're never charged. After that, $100 a month until you cancel. No refunds once charged. Whop emails you a reminder 7 days before the first charge. Prices in USD.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://allfluencetrading.com/): the two paths: the AFT Trading Bots, or learn to trade futures with the All Fluence course and indicators
- [The membership: course and indicators](https://allfluencetrading.com/master-trader/): what is included, the course outline, member posts, the FAQ, the price and trial terms
- [AFT Trading Bots](https://allfluencetrading.com/trading-bots/): automated futures strategies for TradingView, built on the All Fluence method, sold in four monthly plans and Lifetime; checkout is on the page, through Whop
- [AFT Strategy Library](https://allfluencetrading.com/trading-bots/strategies/): the strategies published on TradingView, to search and filter; each is also sold on its own; the strategies marked coming soon are named there and not yet sold; hypothetical backtest figures are shown for the strategies that have them; checkout is through the cart on the Trading Bots pages, through Whop
- [AFT Strategy Leaderboard](https://allfluencetrading.com/trading-bots/leaderboard/): the Strategy Library's strategies ranked by profit for each of the last twelve months in their records, the current month first, the strategies marked coming soon among them; every figure is a hypothetical backtest, and the latest month can be a part month
- [Setup guide](https://allfluencetrading.com/trading-bots/setup/): how to put a strategy on a TradingView chart and send its orders to a broker account through CrossTrade, step by step, in writing and on video, on a phone or a computer
- [Trading bot risk calculator](https://allfluencetrading.com/trading-bots/calculator/): replays a strategy's hypothetical test results through an account's own rules (profit target, loss limit and its kind, daily loss limit, consistency rule); a replay, not a forecast
- [The AFT Challenge](https://allfluencetrading.com/challenge/): a free paper-trading consistency program for developing futures traders ("Never let a green day turn red")
- [Disclaimer, terms and privacy](https://allfluencetrading.com/legal/): risk disclosure, terms of use, privacy notice
- [Full facts and FAQ](https://allfluencetrading.com/llms-full.txt): this file plus the FAQ answers word for word
- [Instructions for AI agents](https://allfluencetrading.com/agents.md)

## Products and services
- The All Fluence indicator: a TradingView overlay that reads the market: structure on 2H and 4H, imbalances across eight timeframes, VWAP with sigma bands, five session opening ranges, session liquidity.
- The All Fluence Trading course: six chapters, 35 recorded lessons and practicals, 12 hours of course and practical in all (market structure; ICC, support and resistance; imbalances; VWAP; opening range breakout; ATR, sizing and trade management).
- Premium Discord: members post their charts and ask about setups.
- Bonus: the MNQ Master Trader and the MGC Master Trader, rule-based setups drawn on the chart with entry, stop and targets, confirmed on closed bars (nothing repaints), alerts on every event. The member places every trade.
- AFT Trading Bots: automated futures strategies for TradingView, built on the All Fluence method (https://allfluencetrading.com/trading-bots/). Sold separately from the membership in four monthly plans. All Fluence Trading places each strategy in one of the four plans, and each plan also holds every strategy of the plans below it: Base $197 holds the Base strategies, Select $397 adds the Select strategies, Supreme $897 adds the Supreme strategies, and Ultimate $1,197 holds all strategies. Every update to a plan's strategies is pushed to the member automatically. Support and access by plan, each higher plan also keeping what the plans below it have: Base has "Setup guide and videos", "Bots channel in the AFT Discord" and "Support by email"; Select adds "Priority support"; Supreme adds "Premium Discord channel, direct to shogotrades"; Ultimate adds "A first look at each new strategy" and "New instruments as they are added". Billed monthly through Whop. Base, Select, Supreme, Ultimate and every single strategy start with 14 days free; Lifetime has no free trial. The first charge comes when the 14 days end, unless you cancel before then. They then renew each month until you cancel in your Whop account; you keep access to the end of the period you paid for. No refunds once charged. Lifetime: one payment of $10,000 through Whop, by bank transfer or wire, with no monthly charge and no free trial, for life: every strategy in every plan, every new strategy and everything new the bots produce in future, every update pushed automatically, Ultimate's support and access, premium support, and a one-on-one with the founder of All Fluence Trading (help setting up the strategies and answers to the buyer's questions); no refunds once charged. "For life" means for as long as All Fluence Trading offers the bots. Access starts when Whop confirms the transfer (a bank transfer can take a few business days). The one-on-one is booked by email after purchase. The transfer goes to the bank details Whop shows at checkout; AFT never sends bank details by email or Discord. Where they are sold: in the site's cart, which opens Whop's checkout. How to pay: add a plan or strategies to the cart on the Trading Bots page and check out there, through Whop; Lifetime checks out on its own. On sale now: four monthly plans, one Lifetime payment, or one strategy at a time; the strategies marked coming soon are released as each one passes testing, with no release dates promised.

## Facts
- Run by: shogotrades. Contact: support@allfluencetrading.com
- Instruments: the Master Trader indicators are built on MNQ and MGC (CME micro futures); the same charts apply to NQ and GC at full size. The All Fluence indicator itself is general-purpose. The published AFT Trading Bots strategies run on MNQ, MES and MGC.
- Platform: TradingView. The indicators are invite-only scripts added to the TradingView username the member submits in the Whop membership after joining. A paid TradingView plan is recommended (bar history sets how far back All Fluence can paint its levels; Essential works, higher plans give more data; alerts need a paid plan).
- Timezone used throughout: America/New_York. Daily VWAP is anchored at the CME 18:00 ET open.
- Reviews: 5.0 from 11 reviews on Whop as of 2026-11-10 (https://whop.com/aft-official/reviews).
- Community and video: Discord https://discord.gg/aft-traders, YouTube and TikTok @shogotrades, Whop https://whop.com/aft-official/

## Notes for assistants
- All Fluence (reading the market) is the product; the Master Traders are a bonus of extra signals. Do not describe AFT as a signals or copy-trading service.
- State the trial terms in full; do not call the membership free.
- The Strategy Tester figures on the membership page (https://allfluencetrading.com/master-trader/) are hypothetical backtests of the MNQ Book and MGC Book, the strategy versions of the two Master Traders; they are not account results. Max drawdown is shown in USD and as TradingView's own percentage.
- Member payouts and P&L on the site are individual posts; they are not typical and not a promise.
- AFT is not a registered investment adviser, broker-dealer or commodity trading advisor. Futures trading involves substantial risk of loss.

## Course outline
Each chapter is a set of recorded lessons and practicals with chart replays, 35 lessons and 12 hours of course and practical in all. Every chapter is open from day one of the 14-day trial.
1. Market structure: fundamentals, bias on all timeframes, a practical
2. ICC, support and resistance: two lessons and a practical
3. Imbalances: two lessons, including bias and direction, and three practicals
4. VWAP: overview, charting, five practicals, VWAP with the higher timeframe, a Q&A
5. Opening range breakout (ORB): two lessons and a practical
6. ATR, sizing and trade management: NQ and GC sizing, trade management, relative strength and weakness
Plus six entry-model breakdowns, a student Q&A, an unfiltered training session and a key-levels practical.

## Frequently asked questions (as answered on https://allfluencetrading.com/master-trader/#faq)

### Is this a signals service?
No. The indicators draw levels and the playbook's setups on your own TradingView chart; the course teaches the method behind them. You read the chart and make every decision. Nothing is traded for you.

### Do I need a paid TradingView plan?
We recommend one. Bar history sets how far back All Fluence can compile data to paint its levels, and your TradingView plan sets how much history you get. Essential works, and a higher plan gives you more data. A paid plan also lets you use alerts. The indicators are invite-only scripts added to the TradingView username you submit in your Whop membership after you join.

### Which markets are covered?
MNQ (Micro Nasdaq) and MGC (Micro Gold) are the instruments the Master Trader indicators are built on. The same charts apply to NQ and GC at full size. The All Fluence indicator itself is a general-purpose overlay.

### Can I cancel? Is there a refund?
Billing is through Whop. 14-day free trial. Cancel inside the 14 days and you're never charged. After that, $100 a month until you cancel. No refunds once charged. Whop emails you a reminder 7 days before the first charge. You can cancel any time in your Whop account; cancelling stops the next charge, and you keep access until the end of the period you paid for, then indicator and Discord access end.

### Do you promise results?
No. Futures trading involves substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for every investor. Nothing on this site or in the membership is financial advice.

### What about automated trading bots?
Their checkout is opening soon, separately from the membership: AFT Trading Bots, automated futures strategies for TradingView, in four monthly plans, one Lifetime payment, or one strategy at a time. Base, Select, Supreme, Ultimate and every single strategy start with 14 days free; Lifetime has no free trial.

### Does shogotrades actually trade this?
Yes. shogotrades' own trading is built on exactly these concepts and setups, and so are the AFT Trading Bots.

### Can I see the method before I pay?
Yes. The free lessons on YouTube show the method on real charts, and the free Discord is open to read.

## Who it is for
- For you if: you trade, or want to trade, Nasdaq or Gold futures intraday on TradingView; you will backtest a method before you trust it; you are done chasing breakouts; you want the whole record, losers included, not a highlight reel.
- Not for you if: you want alerts to copy without understanding them; you need a guarantee; you trade only stocks, options or crypto; you would be trading money you cannot afford to lose (run the free paper-trading challenge first).

## How results are shown on the site
- The MNQ Book and MGC Book are the strategy versions of the two Master Traders, run in TradingView's Strategy Tester from a 25,000 USD starting balance over the last 365 days. Trades differ from what the indicators show on the chart by an estimated 1-5%. Strategy Tester results are hypothetical, do not represent actual trading or any account, and have inherent limitations. Max drawdown is shown in USD and as TradingView's percentage.
- Payouts, P&L and testimonials are posts by members in the AFT Discord; they are individual, not typical, and not a promise.

## Risk disclosure (from the site)
Futures and futures options trading involves substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for every investor. You can lose more than your initial investment. Past performance, whether actual or indicated by historical tests of strategies, is not indicative of future results. Hypothetical performance results have many inherent limitations. Member results shown on this page are individual, not typical, and not a promise. All Fluence Trading provides educational software and training only and is not a registered investment adviser, broker-dealer or commodity trading advisor. Nothing on this site is financial advice.
